title: About
html:
Hi. My name is Al Amin.

I’m a Northern Nigerian writer, photographer, and filmmaker currently based in Berlin, Germany.

I shoot bold, colourful images of people that give them power within the frame. I specialise in portraiture, lifestyle, and editorial photography.

I'm also deeply passionate about helping people connect with their audiences through videos. Over the past decade, I’ve had the good fortune of collaborating with some incredible brands, authors, and artists to help tell their stories.

I’ve also written and directed a couple of short films, music videos, and documentaries that have played all over the world.

Recently, I started a Youtube channel where I make videos about creativity, relationships, and personal growth.

If you think we can work together to create something cool — or you just want to say hello — get in touch via my contact page, or — if you prefer — email hello @ this same domain.
